parameters.query: SELECT m.*, u.id as user_id, u.plan_type, u.api_calls_remaining FROM model_marketplace m JOIN api_keys ak ON m.owner_id = ak.user_id OR ak.user_id IN (SELECT customer_id FROM model_purchases WHERE model_id = m.id) JOIN users u ON ak.user_id = u.id WHERE ak.api_key = '{{ $json.api_key }}' AND m.model_id = '{{ $json.model_id }}' AND m.status = 'active'

UPDATE users SET api_calls_remaining = api_calls_remaining - 1, total_spent = total_spent + {{ $node["Validate Usage Limits"].json["price_per_call"] }} WHERE id = '{{ $node["Validate Usage Limits"].json["user_id"] }}'

INSERT INTO batch_jobs (batch_id, user_id, model_id, total_predictions, status, callback_url, created_at) VALUES ('{{ $json[0].batch_id }}', (SELECT user_id FROM api_keys WHERE api_key = '{{ $json[0].api_key }}'), '{{ $json[0].model_id }}', {{ $json.length }}, 'processing', '{{ $json[0].callback_url }}', NOW()) RETURNING id

SELECT DATE_TRUNC('day', timestamp) as date, model_id, COUNT(*) as total_calls, SUM(cost) as total_revenue, AVG(cost) as avg_cost_per_call FROM api_usage_log WHERE timestamp >= NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days' GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('day', timestamp), model_id ORDER BY date DESC
